LESSON: TAQWA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Taqwa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Taqwa
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What actions lead to piety?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief
3. appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
• Model 2: demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. Practise: demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Taqwa.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What actions lead to piety?
2. Why is taqwa important in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
